name: Partner
description: A couple: spouse, girlfriend or boyfriend, partner. One at a time.

relation.how_many: One at a time, and said once. The type is symmetric, so the two ends are one end: the check follows a symmetric link from both sides off this single field, and declaring the object's end as well would hand the same link over twice.
